query: INSERT INTO deadlock_vocab (term, canonical, category, source, aliases, weight, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::text::jsonb, $6, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (term) DO UPDATE SET canonical = EXCLUDED.canonical, category = EXCLUDED.category, source = EXCLUDED.source, aliases = EXCLUDED.aliases, weight = EXCLUDED.weight, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
